summary: Ellington Credit Company filed an 8-K on October 16, 2026 disclosing that its Board of Trustees authorized, on October 9, 2026, a common share repurchase program of up to $20 million in the open market. The program runs until October 9, 2027, unless extended or terminated, with timing, price and amount at the Fund's discretion; no obligation exists to repurchase shares. The midpoint estimated NAV per share was $4.04 as of September 30, 2026. Watch the pace of buybacks relative to NAV discount, liquidity, and any suspension or expansion of the authorization.
